# GYM OS — by Beyond Pixells

> Gym management software built for Indian gyms. Leads, trial passes, QR door check-ins, GST billing, UPI payments and WhatsApp renewal nudges — one system, flat pricing in rupees, no per-staff fees.

## What it is
GYM OS is a gym operating system for Indian fitness businesses (single gyms and small chains). It replaces paper registers and foreign USD-priced software with a UPI-first, GST-ready system the front desk can actually use.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://gym-os-app.vercel.app/): what it does, live demo of the owner dashboard
- [Pricing](https://gym-os-app.vercel.app/pricing): flat INR plans — setup fee + fixed monthly, unlimited members
- [Compare](https://gym-os-app.vercel.app/compare): GYM OS vs Mindbody vs Gymdesk
- [Console demo](https://gym-os-app.vercel.app/dashboard/#/dashboard): read-only sandbox with seeded data, no signup
- [Blog](https://gym-os-app.vercel.app/blog): guides for Indian gym owners

- Built in India by Beyond Pixells (beyondpixells@gmail.com)
